guarantees.claim: Each element iv[i] is continuously assigned the value of reg2hw.iv[i].q for all i in 0..NumRegsIv-1.
Each element iv_qe[i] is continuously assigned the value of reg2hw.iv[i].qe for all i in 0..NumRegsIv-1.

uncertain_points.claim: If the parameter NumRegsIv is set to a value that does not match the actual number of IV registers (e.g., 4 for AES-128), the iv and iv_qe array sizes will be mismatched, potentially leading to incomplete or incorrect IV loading.
uncertain_points.cond: Misconfiguration of NumRegsIv relative to the AES mode's required IV width.
uncertain_points.risk: AES encryption/decryption uses a truncated or invalid IV, compromising data confidentiality and integrity.
